paper.title: Asymptotically Optimal Best Arm Identification with Fixed-Budget under Differential Privacy

settings.name_in_paper: Fixed-budget Bernoulli best-arm identification under pure epsilon-differential privacy
unmapped: pure epsilon-DP (global, table-level neighbouring reward matrices) required for the full transcript (A_1,...,A_T,A_out)
arm means lie in the open interval (0,1)
settings.definition_quote: We consider a fixed-budget Bernoulli best-arm identification problem with K arms. ... When arm a is pulled, the learner observes an independent reward drawn from Ber(mu_a). We assume that the best arm is unique ... We say that pi is epsilon-DP if for all neighboring r,r', for all instances theta^*, and for all S, M(pi(r) in S) <= e^epsilon M(pi(r') in S).

symbols.tau_star: privacy-aware fixed-budget exponent sup_lambda inf_{theta' in Alt(theta*)} d_eps(theta', theta*, lambda), where d_eps(theta1,theta2,lambda)=inf_{theta'} E_{a~lambda}[eps*TV(Ber(mu_{1,a}),Ber(mu'_a)) + KL(Ber(mu'_a)||Ber(mu_{2,a}))]

conditions: there exists an instance-independent allocation lambda* such that N_{a,T}/T -> lambda*_a a.s. for every instance and arm

source.label: thm:LowerBound
source.quote: Suppose a policy \(\pi\) is consistent and \(\epsilon\)-DP. Assume further that there exists an allocation \(\lambda^*\in\Delta_{[K]}\) such that, for every problem instance \(\theta\in\Theta\), the arm counts generated by \(\pi\) satisfy $\lim_{T\to\infty}\frac{N_{a,T}}{T}=\lambda_a^*$ a.s. for all $a\in[K]$. Then \[\limsup_{T\to\infty}-\frac1T\log\mathbb M_{\theta^*,\pi}(A_{\mathrm{out}}\neq a_{\theta^*})\le \tau^*(\theta^*)...\]

results.notes: Statement is limsup -(1/T) log P(error) <= tau*, i.e. error probability is not smaller than exp(-T(tau*+o(1))); encoded as exp(-tau_star*T) with limsup notation. Concerns the unconditional error probability.

symbols.tau_star: privacy-aware fixed-budget exponent sup_lambda inf_{theta' in Alt(theta*)} d_eps(theta', theta*, lambda)

conditions: error probability is conditional on the history: P_{theta ~ q_Final}(A_out != a*) = q_Final(Alt(theta*)), holding along almost every sample path
results.notes: Bound on the conditional (given history) error probability of the randomized final recommendation, a.s.; paper explicitly says it does not imply the same rate for the unconditional error probability. Encoded as exp(-tau_star*T) with liminf notation. Algorithm also proven epsilon-DP (Theorem 5.1). Compute: sampling via log-concave rejection sampling; marked polynomial per the paper's tractability discussion.

cited_results.setting_description: Fixed-budget best-arm identification in linear bandits under pure epsilon-DP, bounded rewards

bound.expression_latex: \exp\bigl(-\Omega(T/(H(\theta^{*})\log d))\bigr),\ H(\theta^*)=\max_{2\le i\le (d^2\wedge K)} \frac{i}{\Delta_{(i)}^2}+\frac{1}{\epsilon}\max_{2\le i\le(d^2\wedge K)}\frac{i}{\Delta_{(i)}}

cited_results.where: Section 6, Comparison with existing private BAI guarantees

cited_results.setting_description: Prediction with expert advice (full information), losses in [0,1], K experts
